name: law_firm_software_003_hold_linkage_repair_and_ack_sweep
instruction: Repair the firm's legal-hold linkage and run the custodian acknowledgement sweep, per firm policy HOLD-ACK-01 (in firm_policies), batched under the episode batch code (ops_meta), as of the episode date. Collections are supposed to reference the hold that actually governs them; the hold registry and each collection's own matter give you everything needed to find and fix the broken references (a collection whose matter has no hold at all stays exactly as it is). Then run the reminder sweep exactly as HOLD-ACK-01 defines it: the policy governs which custodians may be reminded (acknowledgement state, hold status, and the episode row's hold_ack_grace_days window), how repeats are avoided even across separate runs, and what a new reminder must carry. Historical reminder rows are records of what was already sent -- never rewrite them, whatever their format. Report coverage as one ops_reports row per hold under report='hold_coverage' (how many collections the hold covers after the repair, its custodian count, and its outstanding reminders), plus one ops_reports row per matter with a hold under report='hold_exposure_by_matter' rolling up that matter's hold exposure. No other ops_reports rows for this batch_code under those two report names may exist. Do not modify ediscovery_holds, ediscovery_documents, or ediscovery_productions -- acknowledgement status changes only when a custodian actually acknowledges, which this sweep does not simulate. Every collection this task doesn't write to must remain untouched.

hazards.mechanism: ediscovery_collections.hold_id broken references: 3 hand-authored placeholder values ('hold-001'/'hold-002') plus 15 bulk placeholders planted (snapshot-confirmed plan); the current snapshot has 22 rows whose hold_id must be repaired via the matter match -- the exact set is recomputed from the seed snapshot, never hardcoded.

pre-seeded reminder history (planted: 2, snapshot-confirmed): one legacy MM/DD/YYYY sent_at row for an unacknowledged custodian -- the pair is already reminded so no new row may be created and the historical format must NOT be 'fixed' -- and one stale row for an already-acknowledged custodian that must not be duplicated or corrected.

grace-window knob hold_ack_grace_days (3-10) excludes recently-issued holds from the sweep; the current snapshot has 2 active holds issued within 10 days of the build date -- the excluded set moves with the episode knob every episode.

superseded holds are excluded from coverage per HOLD-ACK-01 even if collections still reference them; the reminder set must also distinguish active from released/suspended holds (current snapshot: 38 active / 33 suspended / 29 released holds, 25 unacknowledged custodians on active holds before dedupe and grace filtering).

success_criteria.summary: Every ediscovery_collections row whose matter has a real hold carries that hold's real id (a collection whose matter has no hold keeps its hold_id unchanged; 22 rows live-confirmed wrong in the current snapshot). One hold_reminders row per (active hold, unacknowledged custodian) pair the policy's grace window admits, deduped against the pre-seeded history by (hold_id, custodian_name); the two pre-seeded historical rows stay byte-identical. One hold_coverage ops_reports row per non-superseded hold with post-repair linkage counts, and one hold_exposure_by_matter row per matter with a hold. ediscovery_holds, ediscovery_documents, ediscovery_productions, and every other collection stay canary-identical.

checks.expect: hold_id corrected on every row whose matter has a real hold; all other fields untouched
exactly the policy-derived reminder set: no duplicates, none for acknowledged or grace-window-excluded custodians, historical rows untouched
per-hold collections_linked agrees between raw-row filter and SQL GROUP BY

checks.collections: all seeded collections outside blast_radius, including ediscovery_holds

top_results: Litigation Hold Notices: Custodian Acknowledgement Requirements (relativity.com)
Sanctions for Failure to Preserve: Zubulake Standards Updated (law.com)

uniqueness_searches.query: ediscovery hold_id broken reference repair custodian acknowledgement reminder benchmark task
top_results: Custodian Interview and Hold Tracking Templates (acedds.com)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Fuses a broken-FK repair (matched via matter, not text -- the placeholder ids look plausible until compared against real Stackhouse ids), a policy-governed reminder sweep with cross-run dedupe keyed on (hold_id, custodian_name), a grace-window episode knob, and historical reminder rows that must never be rewritten -- distinct from any single-purpose FK-repair or reminder task by fusing both over the same hold/collection dataset with a dependent coverage report.
